aboutArtist.title: Fiha Islam
aboutArtist.role: Fine Artist & Founder, Artora by FramEmpire
aboutArtist.bio1: Based in Kutubpur, Fatullah, Narayanganj, Dhaka, Fiha Islam is the lead artist and creative founder behind Artora by FramEmpire. Specializing in heavy acrylic impasto, 24k gold leaf gilding, and hand-painted wearable silks, she crafts statement art pieces tailored for modern architectural spaces.
aboutArtist.bio2: Her signature palette knife technique and rich dimensional textures bring walls alive with radiant warmth and contemporary depth. Every canvas is 100% original, sealed with archival museum varnish for collectors worldwide.
